# One transaction bringing USD into two accounts, priced through two CAD
# splits whose own ratios differ.
#
# The rate belongs to the transaction, not to either basis: both USD splits
# are priced through the same CAD lines, so both cost the same, and that cost
# is the aggregate of those lines rather than whichever is read first.
#
# What this fixture produces: two cost bases, both at 150.00 CAD over 108.00
# USD.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_verify_costs.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Cash
	type: Cash
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Cash:USD
	type: Cash
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "100 USD into two accounts, with a CAD fee at another rate"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 60.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "60.00"
	Assets:Cash:USD 40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "40.00"
	Assets:Bank:USD -8.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-8.00"
	Income:Sales -140.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "-100.00"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 10.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "8.00"
